author: Vaekyuo
title: Hiring 2D Artist, VFX Artist + UI Designer for Roblox RPG
content:
1/ 🎨 HIRING: 2D ARTIST, VFX ARTIST + UI DESIGNER 🎨
Solo dev making VAETRX, a hero RPG on Roblox where every hero comes from mythical folklore.

Paying CAD$ or Robux. DM your portfolio 👇
#RobloxDev #lookingforartist #artcommission #RobloxVFX

Detailed requirements: Roblox avatar style with detailed painted art (cloth folds, shiny metal, fur, feathers); layered PSD for live 2D animation (breathing, hair/cape sway, particles); background scenes with depth and lighting; dynamic full-body poses and cards. Contact: DM portfolio here or on Discord: vaekyuo
